blocks.text: Peak meters in every app titlebar — tiny level indicator shows signal activity at a glance.
Wire colours by signal type — audio wires are orange, CV/mod wires are blue, MIDI wires are green.
Workspace right-click menu — tile, cascade, lock, or close all windows from the background.
Lock workspace — prevents accidental window moves and resizes. Toggle via right-click menu.

New app icon, panic button, shortcuts panel, window position memory, undo/redo, knob reset, value pills, tap tempo, mute, accent colours per instance, zoom shortcuts, hint mode, swing fix, rAF loop fixes.
Multi-band Compressor, Glitch, Distortion and Update Checker bug fixes. macOS build added.
